subject: Regarding allotment of districts/field offices for district-level training to probationer officers of the cadre of Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Guidance Officer (Group-B) under Combined Probationary Training Programme-12 (CPTP-12).

preamble: Pursuant to the General Administration Department's two separate office orders dated 28.07.2026 and 06.08.2026 (Reference Nos. 3 and 5), candidates recommended for appointment to Group-B posts in government service based on the final results of the State Services Examination, 2024 conducted by the Maharashtra Public Service Commission, have been appointed as probationary officers under the Combined Probationary Training Programme-12 (CPTP-12) for a period of 2 years from 10.08.2026. Furthermore, guidelines for CPTP-12 have been issued vide Government Circular dated 31.07.2026 at Reference No. 4. Among the officers appointed as probationer officers under CPTP-12, 6 officers belong to the cadre of Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Guidance Officer (Group-B) under the Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Directorate.
order_paragraphs: Vide General Administration Department's Government Resolution dated 01.08.2025 at Reference No. 1, the syllabus and structure of the combined probationary training program for officers appointed to Group-A and Group-B posts in government service through the State Services Examination by the Maharashtra Public Service Commission has been finalized. Subsequently, the said structure was amended vide Government Corrigendum dated 12.09.2025 at Reference No. 2. As per the revised structure, the 2-year probationary period is to be implemented in 4 semesters. As per the revised structure, training under district attachment will be imparted for the initial 4 weeks at the beginning of training, 12 weeks in Semester 3, and 60 weeks in Semester 4 (independent charge). Accordingly, 6 candidates of the Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Guidance Officer (Group-B) cadre appointed as probationary officers under CPTP-12 are hereby posted for district-level training to the district/field offices shown against their names in the table below.

subsequent_paragraphs: If deemed administratively necessary, changes in the aforesaid appointments will be made by the Administrative Department.
The aforesaid probationary officers should report to their allotted offices for district-level training on 10.08.2026 (forenoon).

The Commissioner, Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Directorate, Navi Mumbai, shall take necessary further action regarding the district-level training of the aforesaid probationary officers. The Commissioner shall ensure that the instructions given vide Government Resolutions/Circulars/Office Orders of the General Administration Department at Reference Nos. 1 to 5 are strictly complied with.
